dev.hero_sub: Injiza amategeko y'umuhanda mu Rwanda, ibibazo by'ibizamini, ibyapa by'umuhanda, n'amakarita y'imyitozo muri porogaramu yawe.
dev.step1_desc: Kora API key yawe ku buntu hejuru. Ntikenewe kwiyandikisha.
dev.step2_desc: Shyiramo X-API-Key muri buri busabe, hanyuma ukore amasabe kuri endpoint zose.
dev.step3_desc: Koresha JSON mu porogaramu yawe. Igisubizo cyose kizaba kirimo ikirango cya Ferrivox Ltd.
dev.keys_signin: Injira kugira ngo ukore API key zawe.
dev.branding_desc: Igisubizo cyose kirimo _poweredBy. Iyo ugaragaza amakuru ya API ya ISHAMI, ugomba kugaragaza ko ari ibya Ferrivox Ltd.
dev.auth_desc: Ibisabwa byose bisaba API key yemewe, yoherejwe mu mutwe wa X-API-Key. Umubare ntarengwa: 60 ibisabwa mu munota.
dev.pricing_desc: Hitamo urwego rukwiye ibyo ukeneye. Tangira ku buntu, uzamure igihe cyose ubishaka.
dev.custom_desc: Twandikire timu yacu kugira ngo tuganire ku biciro byihariye.
dev.footer_key: Iyo ushaka API key, twandikire kuri
